dedup_rule: One usage record per assistant turn: the usage payload of each `message_end` event is the only measurement. Duplicates and their effect on a naive sum: `message_start` carries a zero placeholder (no inflation); `turn_end` repeats the message_end payload verbatim (tokens 2x, cost 2x); `agent_end` embeds a further copy (tokens 3x if also counted). Cost additionally doubles if a naively summed cost object includes both `total` and its four components, so summing every numeric cost field over message_end+turn_end yields 4x. The previous ledger values (216/90 records, 2x tokens, 4x cost) are exactly that naive sum. Cost here is taken from each record's `cost.total`, which already equals the sum of its input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite components. Token sums from `message_end` reproduce attempt-1 93782/76582/5568000/5738364, attempt-2 12388/52488/6292608/6357484 and attempt-3 14924/42774/7879424/7937122.
